text:
noah: quick thread to lock GA readiness items that still block launch. focus: SLA wording, pricing tiers (reserved + burst), docs expectations, oncall/runbooks, and monitoring alarms. keeping it tight. who picks what? :clipboard:
anya: I'll take docs + runbook. plan: GA "What to expect" + Quickstart + troubleshooting. need final SLO numbers and error budget to write clear guidance.
david: I'll take SLA language + tests. proposing availability 99.95 for Hosted Gold, 99.9 for Hosted Standard, with explicit fallback policy. will sketch draft by EOD.
tess: Ops/infra here 1%: we need to finalize burst policy: how long can burst run, and what eviction order for queued requests? also need per-route quotas for noisy customers.
finance-bot: finance-bot: please include projected per-token cost and expected margin per tier. finance review in 24-48h after numbers landed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary to staging scheduled 2025-02-01 04:00 UTC. smoke tests include tail-latency, p95/p99, and cost per-1k-tokens metric.
noah: draft SLA proposal (high level):
```
SLA (proposal):
- Hosted Standard: Availability SLO 99.9% monthly; error budget 0.1%
- Hosted Gold: Availability SLO 99.95% monthly; priority routing & faster support
- Latency: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms for generation <=512 tokens (with caching)
- Degradation policy: when infra overloaded, automatic fallback to compatible low-memory model; customers notified via incidents and degraded routing recorded
- Refund policy: pro-rated credits when monthly availability < SLO threshold; dispute response within 3 business days
```
anya: docs notes: will add: how we measure availability, what counts as outage, runbook steps for common incidents, and how customers can request credits. will link SLA page to Quickstart and Subscriptions page.
tess: onburst rules: recommend default burst window 5m with 2x reserved throughput, after which token-limited throttling applies and tail-latency alerts fire. eviction order: best-effort -> background tasks -> long-running syncs. need product sign-off.
david: tests: I'll add synthetic load tests and an integration that fails over to low-memory model to validate correctness. will include a small harness in the infra repo.
noah: pricing ask: need defined reserved tiers (small/medium/large) with token caps, baseline throughput, and burst multipliers. Kevin from finance/pm to finalize public price.
finance-bot: finance-bot: pinged kevin for final tier mapping.
noah: action items + owners/due:
- David: SLA wording + test harness (due Thu EOD)
- Anya: Docs + GA Quickstart + runbook skeleton (due Fri 11:00 PT)
- Tess: define burst/eviction policy + per-route quota proposal (due Wed noon)
- Kevin: publish-tier pricing + margin sign-off (TBD on infra numbers)
- Infra: provide per-token cost + long-tail perf numbers (urgent)

Please react with :thumbsup: if you can hit these deadlines or :warning: if blocked. planning a 20m lock call Wed 09:30 PT to sign-off final wording.
david: +1 will file PR and tests.
anya: ack 00: will post PR link when ready.
tess: :warning: still waiting on cost telemetry to size eviction thresholds.
noah: noted 10: I'll escalate cost telemetry request. Thanks everyone.
